description: Find test cases in a project by filters (folder, priority, automation status, type, tags) and/or search (matches test case ID like TC-123, or title; minimum 3 characters) — returns summaries. Filters combine (AND). Pass case_id instead to get one case's full detail (steps, BDD scenarios, field values).

automation_status.description: Filter by automation status (e.g. Automated, Not Automated, To Be Automated)

case_id.description: Test case ID (ULID). When given, returns that case's full detail and all other filters are ignored.

priority.description: Filter by priority (e.g. Lowest, Low, Medium, High, Highest)

project_id.description: Project ID (ULID). Required unless case_id is given.

type.description: Filter by test type (e.g. Functional, Regression, Smoke & Sanity)

name: tm_get_test_cases
title: Find / Get Test Cases
